review_basis: registered MHLW model SDS/label source versions and pinpoint Section 2/9 locators
exam relevance, semantic distinctness and educational value

decisions.rationale: Exact gasoline flash-point proposition; high-value and absent from canonical 51.
Gasoline water insolubility is source-explicit and operationally relevant.
Gasoline liquid relative-density boundary is exact and distinct from vapor density.
Gasoline vapor-density proposition supports vapor-migration reasoning and is source-explicit.
Kerosene flash-point range is source-defined and materially contrasts with low-flash-point liquids.
Kerosene water insolubility is an independently testable substance property.
Acetone flash point is exact, relevant and not represented in canonical 51.
Acetone water solubility creates a meaningful contrast with hydrocarbon liquids.
Ethanol flash point is source-explicit and distinct from its water miscibility.
Ethanol-water miscibility is a core alcohol property and not a wording-only variant.
Methanol flash point is exact and educationally distinct from ethanol despite similar magnitude.
Methanol vapor density tests a separate physical property with direct vapor-behavior relevance.
Toluene flash point is source-explicit and absent from canonical 51.
Toluene liquid density explicitly distinguishes liquid density from vapor density.
Benzene flash point is exact and tests a common boiling-point/flash-point misconception.
Xylene vapor density is source-explicit and operationally relevant to low-area vapor accumulation.
Ethyl acetate flash point is exact and distinct from the existing extinguishing-method question.
Ethyl acetate vapor density is a separate answer-defining proposition from flash point and extinguishing media.

The four-substance ranking depends on four SDS records, but the candidate contract binds only one source_id/version. Rework into a single-source proposition or adopt an explicit source-bundle contract before acceptance.
decisions.resume_condition: Persist reproducible versioned evidence for every compared flash point under an authoritative multi-source binding mechanism, or rewrite as a single-source question.

decisions.rationale: The four-substance solubility grouping cannot be independently reconstructed from the single bound source_id alone. The locator text is not a substitute for versioned source bindings.
decisions.resume_condition: Bind every compared substance through an approved source bundle, or reduce the question to a proposition supported by one registered source.

collision_review.note: No accepted B4 candidate materially collides with canonical 51 or accepted B5/B6 propositions. C019/C020 are held from acceptance because their answer-defining comparisons exceed the single-source binding contract.
